review_page.readFailed: The run's review can't be read
review_page.noRunBody: The task has no run that waits for your review or was sent back from it.
review_page.nothingBody: The run has no checkpoint, so its work has no diff to review.
review_page.tooLargeBody: The run changes {{files}} files, more than Orchester reads. Review {{branch}} with git, then approve it from its task page.

changed.title: Changed since your review
changed.body: The branch moved from {{reviewed}}, the head you reviewed, to {{head}}: {{commits}}. The diff shows {{head}}; look at it, then approve it.
changed.reason: Changed since your review: review the new commits first.

diff.binary: A binary file: its changes are not shown as lines.
diff.unchanged: Moved from {{path}} without changing its content.

thread.question: Question
thread.outdatedFold: {{count}} outdated: a later commit changed their lines. Show them

tag.sent: Sent · Implement is changing the code

composer.commentHint: A comment waits in the tray until you send all of them to Implement.
composer.questionHint: Sent to Implement at once; it answers here without changing the code.
composer.editHint: The comment isn't sent yet, so it can still change.
composer.replyHint: Your reply waits in the tray as a new comment.

tray.whatOne: Implement changes the code for it, then the run waits for your review again.
tray.whatOther: Implement changes the code for them, then the run waits for your review again.
tray.failedRunner: Not sent: the runner is not running
tray.failedRunnerDetail: The send failed; nothing is lost. Your comments are kept. Start the project's runner, or try again.
tray.failedDetail: The send failed; nothing is lost. Your comments are kept.

approveAsk.bodyOne: Your comment on {{file}}, {{lines}}, has not reached the agent. Send it to Implement to have it addressed first, or approve and merge without it; the comment is then discarded.
approveAsk.bodyOther: Your {{count}} comments have not reached the agent. Send them to Implement to have them addressed first, or approve and merge without them; the comments are then discarded.

discard.body: They are deleted and never reach Implement. Questions and sent comments stay.
